descriptors.R: the sitting President, nominee of the party that has held the White House since 1981
descriptors.D: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since 1987; a sitting Southern governor
descriptors.O: independent candidate outside both parties; a self-funded business executive running on cutting the federal debt and against the proposed free-trade agreement with Mexico

compile_desc.R: the party that has held the White House since 1981
compile_desc.D: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since 1987

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including a Libertarian, a Populist and a New Alliance party nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Bush, Clinton, Perot, Quayle, Gore, Stockdale, Reagan, Tsongas, Jerry Brown, Buchanan, Marrou, Gritz or Fulani

slice_sources.men: 1990 census (NHGIS) interpolated toward the 2000 census to November 1992; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1992); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1992 returns.
slice_sources.women: 1990 census (NHGIS) interpolated toward the 2000 census to November 1992; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1992); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1992 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 1990 census (NHGIS) interpolated toward the 2000 census to November 1992; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1992); calibrated to the certified 1992 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1990 census (NHGIS) interpolated toward the 2000 census to November 1992; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1992), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 1992 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 1990 census (NHGIS) interpolated toward the 2000 census to November 1992; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the congressional majority party
